title: Diagnostic Accuracy Is Not Deployment Value: Decision-Aligned Reliability Evaluation for Foundation MLIPs in Materials Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.30066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In AI-guided materials discovery, machine-learning models increasingly decide which candidate materials should receive expensive first-principles or experimental evaluation. Standard reliability metrics such as uncertainty, calibration, novelty, and ranking accuracy evaluate properties of the predictions, but success on these metrics does not necessarily imply a better downstream screening decision. We study this mismatch for foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MACE-MP, CHGNet, Orb V3) used to rank candidate crystal structures before DFT verification. We evaluate three representative reliability interventions (novelty detection, sparse DFT calibration, and chemistry-level ranking audits) using a deployment objective that measures how much DFT can be avoided while maintaining a required recall of near-hull candidates. translated_title: 诊断准确性不等于部署价值：材料发现中基础机器学习原子间势的决策对齐可靠性评估
translated_abstract: 在AI引导的材料发现中，机器学习模型越来越多地承担起决定哪些候选材料应当接受昂贵的第一性原理计算或实验评估的任务。不确定性、校准、新颖性和排序准确性等标准可靠性指标评估的是预测本身的属性，但在这些指标上的成功并不一定意味着更好的下游筛选决策。我们针对基础机器学习原子间势（MACE-MP、CHGNet、Orb V3）研究了这种不匹配问题，这些模型用于在DFT验证之前对候选晶体结构进行排序。我们使用一个部署目标来评估三种代表性的可靠性干预措施（新颖性检测、稀疏DFT校准和化学层面的排序审计），该部署目标衡量在保持对近凸包候选材料所需召回率的前提下，能够节省多少DFT计算。在所有三种干预中，可靠性信号都可以在其直接目标上取得成功，却不改善最终的筛选决策。
tldr: 论文通过决策对齐的评估框架证明，基础机器学习原子间势在标准可靠性指标上的成功并不能转化为更好的材料筛选部署决策，提出了以节省DFT计算同时保持召回率为目标的可靠性评估方法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that success on standard reliability metrics does not translate into better screening decisions, and proposes a decision-aligned evaluation framework measuring DFT savings at fixed recall for foundation MLIPs in materials discovery.
